prompts.prompt: EDIT TARGET: Image1, the 16-pose crowned scarecrow king animation sheet. AUTHORITATIVE ART STYLE REFERENCE: Image2, the existing Magic Drink clown sprites. Same amount of detail as the clown: a few broad straw tufts, simple cloth patches; NO individually rendered straw fibres, burlap grain, realistic surface textures, gritty painterly lighting, realism, thin scratchy lines or horror-game anatomy. He should read as a theatrical cartoon scarecrow villain next to that clown. Keep scarecrow identity: straw crown, patched green coat, red scarf, wooden pitchfork held consistently in the same hand. Preserve EXACTLY the 4 columns x4 rows and all 16 action poses/chronology from image1, all facing LEFT, all fullbody.
